landing.badge: Live resume builder with real AI
landing.title: The resume that gets past the filter
landing.subtitle: Write, rewrite and export a resume that clears both the recruiter's eyes and the ATS parser — with a live preview and AI that actually helps.

features.title: Everything you need, in one editor
features.subtitle: No copy-pasting between tools, no guessing what the parser wants.
features.liveDescription: Every keystroke redraws the page exactly as it will export. Switch between twelve templates and watch the layout re-flow.
features.aiDescription: Sharpen your summary, turn duties into measurable impact, and expand thin bullet points — without the generic filler.
features.atsTitle: ATS score you can act on
features.atsDescription: See exactly which keywords, dates and sections the parser looks for, and what to fix first.
features.exportDescription: PDF for applications, Word for editing, PNG for your portfolio, and LaTeX when you want typographic control.
features.privacyDescription: Every resume is scoped to your account, served over TLS, and never shared with a third party.

landing.templatesTitle: Twelve templates, from ATS-safe to expressive
landing.templatesSubtitle: Each one is built from the same content model, so switching never loses a word.
landing.step1Description: One email and a password. Your resumes are private to you from the first keystroke.
landing.step2Description: Section-by-section fields with hints, so you never have to remember what an ATS wants to see.
landing.step3Description: Run the ATS check, apply the suggestions, then export a file that is ready to send.
landing.footerTagline: ResumeForge AI — build, enhance and export a resume that gets read.
